title: Sort the Jumbled Numbers
goal: Sort numbers by their digit-mapped values while preserving ties in original order.
strategy: Map every decimal digit, including the single digit of zero. Leading mapped zeros do not contribute numeric weight; decorate each value with its mapped number and original index before sorting.
